title: Identifiable Regime Detection in Pension Fund Networks via Sticky Hidden Markov Models
description: Replication code for the manuscript "Identifiable Regime Detection in Pension Fund Networks via Sticky Hidden Markov Models". The package computes a rolling-window absorption ratio on a panel of pension fund returns, identifies clusters of co-moving funds with DTW dissimilarity and average-linkage hierarchical clustering, and detects regime structure in the absorption ratio with a sticky Hidden Markov Model fit by EM and validated by Bayesian inference under label-switching-corrected identifiability diagnostics. A synthetic dataset generator is included so the full pipeline can be reproduced end-to-end without access to the original Lithuanian pension fund data.
notes: Developed within the MSCA DIGITAL Industrial Doctoral Network (Marie Sklodowska-Curie grant agreement No. 101119635). Submitted to Mathematics (MDPI), Special Issue: Machine Learning, Statistics and Big Data, 2nd Edition.
